_comment: Manual fixes applied by gen_events.py on every run (EVENTS.md, D3). Never hand-edit src/events/EventData.*.
exclude_metas: wiki timer rows that are no events (day/night cycles, the time ruler).
metas: per wiki meta key. merge: all segments are ONE event moving between places (rotating, e.g. the
Ley-Line Anomaly). alias maps a segment to another (one occurrence); exclude_segments drops
pure states (D1); name / name_de format each segment's event name. Placeholders: {segment} {segment_de}
{meta} {meta_de} {map} {map_de}. map / map_de set the map for segments without a waypoint.
events: per event id (after formatting): id (rename), name, name_de, exclude; map, map_de, waypoint fix
categories_de: German names of the wiki categories; expansion names stay unchanged (D5).
